mechanism: Tobramycin (aminoglycoside) may cause nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity, while carvedilol can mask tachycardia symptoms of aminoglycoside toxicity and may impair renal perfusion through beta-blockade.
action: Monitor renal function (serum creatinine, BUN) and tobramycin levels regularly; assess for ototoxicity symptoms; ensure adequate hydration and consider dosage adjustments based on renal function.
